block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.system: Cornerstone C11 Engine Block 2 Opening Specialization
block_1_metadata.role: Canonical Template Schema for Opening Frontiers, Archetypes, C++ Compatibility & Chassis Isolation
invariants: Strict ISO C11 adherence (-std=c11, -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic) with C++ extern "C" header compatibility
Canonical Block 2 templates govern universal fallback + 4 header archetypes + 2 source archetypes
Block 3 remains pure business logic: inlines live in 2.4; optional monitored non-inline support lives in 2.5

include_tiers: /* --- Tier 1: Standard ISO C11 Library Headers --- */
/* --- Tier 2: External Library Dependencies (None in Layer 0/1) --- */
block_3_body.posix_feature_macro_rule: In .c only when POSIX extensions (<unistd.h>, lstat, readlink, gmtime_r) are required: guard with #ifndef _POSIX_C_SOURCE / #define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L / #endif strictly above the BLOCK 2 banner and prior to Tier 1 includes.
block_3_body.cpp_compatibility_rule: Every engine .h header opens `#ifdef __cplusplus extern "C" { #endif` strictly after Tier 3 #includes (never wrapping system/engine includes) and closes it in Block 5 immediately before `#endif /* <GUARD> */`. Both .h inlines and .c implementation constructs avoid implicit void* casts and C++ reserved identifiers.
block_3_body.static_assert_rule: Include <assert.h> in Tier 1 when compile-time proofs are declared and place portable `static_assert(...)` checks inside Sub-Assembly 2.1 immediately after the constants they prove.

sub_assembly_roles.Sub-Assembly 2.1: Constants, physical chassis limits, module ID, LOCAL_LOG_CAT / LOCAL_MODULE_TAG (.c), and portable `static_assert` proofs (no typedefs or .rodata tables).
sub_assembly_roles.Sub-Assembly 2.2: Contract manifest anchor (.h operational/stateful fallback), constituent index (.h facade), stateless ID (.h pure_types), OR file-private enums/structs & probe forward declarations (.c).
sub_assembly_roles.Sub-Assembly 2.3: Public tagged ontology with Dual-Audience & per-field Doxygen (.h), cross-cog type map (.h facade), OR 100% unified .rodata/.data/.bss chassis (s_*_invariants, *_manifest, lookup tables, s_state, s_*_probes[]) (.c).
sub_assembly_roles.Sub-Assembly 2.4: Pure O(1) `static inline` pre-conditional predicates, clamps, enum stringifiers, public convenience ergonomic `#define` macros (e.g. `LOG_RECORD`..`LOG_CHAR_MSG`), and scoped `*_EMIT_LOG` / `LOG_SET_TRIPWIRE` frontier macros.
sub_assembly_roles.Sub-Assembly 2.5: Optional (.c ONLY) monitored non-inline `static` Support Infrastructure declared prior to Block 3 so Block 3 stays pure business logic; requires Support Role + Pattern Watch header and zero global .bss buffers.

sub_assembly_2_5_contract.pattern_emergence_purpose: Accumulating coherent non-inline support helpers in 2.5 makes emerging shared capabilities (e.g., JSON span scanning, POSIX symlink resolution) explicitly visible as future standalone file/cog splits without cluttering Block 3.

block_3_body.logging_and_debugging_setup_contract: Block 2 wires a .c module's logging and debugger instrumentation cleanly across sub-assemblies: 2.1 declares MODULE_ID, LOCAL_LOG_CAT, LOCAL_MODULE_TAG; 2.2 forward-declares Block 4 probe callbacks; 2.3 registers s_*_probes[] & fault/tripwire state; 2.4 provides *_EMIT_LOG / tripwire latch inlines; 2.5 (optional) hosts non-inline fault/probe telemetry support helpers.
block_3_body.pure_types_extraction_rule: Whenever an operational header and its quarantined fallback share enums, config structs, or value predicates (e.g., log/log_types.h, debug/debug_types.h, audio/audio_types.h), extract them into a `pure_types` header included in Tier 3 by both, guaranteeing standalone compilation without forward-declaration hacks or mid-file includes.
block_3_body.quarantined_fallback_include_rule: Quarantined fallback headers (*_fallback.h) include ONLY core/manifest.h, matching *_types.h, or sibling *_fallback.h in Tier 3 and never non-fallback primary headers; operational .h headers include paired *_fallback.h cleanly in Tier 3 prior to extern "C".
block_3_body.fallback_c_coordination_rule: Layer 0 fallback .c files bind their paired *_rom.h vault and sibling BIOS interfaces cleanly; avoid importing higher operational I/O parsers (master_loader, json_utils, fs_utils) where BIOS recovery suffices.
block_3_body.controlled_memory_chassis_rule: All .bss/.data state, shared VFS/JSON scratch buffers, invariants tables, probe descriptors, and static test string literals reside in Sub-Assembly 2.3; zero function-local static arrays inside 2.4, 2.5, Block 3, or Block 4.

anti_domain_bleed.forbidden_engine_lore_rule: Engine diagnostic cards, probes, and telemetry use generic Cornerstone schema slots/labels with zero hardcoded Tenebris and Lux proper character, relic, or ending names.
